title: Jacob Heyward 2017 BOWMAN CHROME DRAFT PROSPECT REFRACTOR #BDC-22 GIANTS
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2017 Bowman Chrome trading card features Jacob Heyward, a prospective draft pick from the San Francisco Giants. The card is a Chrome Refractor parallel variety, with a card number of BDC-22. It belongs to the modern era of baseball, manufactured by Bowman in the year 2017. The card is a part of the 2017 Bowman Chrome set and is a sports trading card of the type Trading Card Singles.
